text: Being here, I feel a sense of curiosity and anticipation. The modern, clean lines of the space and the glass walls invite reflection on the boundaries between openness and privacy. Entering the exhibition area, I am drawn to the idea of research and development—'R+D'—sparking contemplation about the future, innovation, and my place within the evolving interplay of technology and humanity. I feel hopeful and intellectually stimulated, surrounded by ideas actively shaping tomorrow.
